Bank data: accounts, balances, transactions and identity, for the Items an app links.

## API key

- **Get your key here:** [dashboard.plaid.com](https://dashboard.plaid.com/developers/keys)
- **Setting:** `PLAID_SECRET`
- **API reference:** [plaid.com](https://plaid.com/docs/api/)

**Unverified.** Nobody has checked this entry against the provider's own docs yet. If something here is wrong, [tell us](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Fix%20provider%20docs%3A%20).

### Get the key

1. Sign in to Plaid and open [dashboard.plaid.com](https://dashboard.plaid.com/developers/keys).
2. Create an API key (or token) with only the access your apps need.
3. Copy it. Many providers show a key only once.

**What to create:** Plaid needs a client\_id and a secret on every call, in the JSON body or in the PLAID-CLIENT-ID and PLAID-SECRET headers. The Gateway puts on one header, so the app would have to send PLAID-CLIENT-ID itself. Every endpoint is a POST.

Steps for this provider are brief. [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Plaid) to request a full guide.

### Set it on your Gateway

From your EveryApp folder:

```bash
pnpm everyapp secret set PLAID_SECRET
```

It asks for the value at a hidden prompt, and it's live at once, with no deploy. If an app you've installed needs it, `pnpm everyapp configure <app>` asks for it along with everything else the app needs.

### Use it in an app

List it in the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  plaid: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

`access` is `"read"`. The app calls the provider's own URLs with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

### Check it worked

- `pnpm everyapp provider show plaid` shows the key as set and which apps use it.
- `pnpm everyapp status` shows apps that were waiting for it as ready.

### Cost and limits

- **Rate limits:** Set per endpoint and per Item: /accounts/get allows 15 a minute per Item and 15,000 a minute per client.
